validation_rules: outputs/mobile-applicability.json is the in-worker platform-marker probe receipt (ADR-0010 G6 = A: no separate applicability node exists); a mobile result of any status without it is rejected
platform markers are AndroidManifest.xml, the Android Gradle plugin, Info.plist and Xcode projects; bare *.java, *.kt or *.m counts are not a marker
the result names android and ios exactly once each, and marker_present equals the receipt's applicable flag for that platform's tool
a rule hit names a platform whose marker is present and that platform's tool, and cites a source file by normalized path, sha256 and line; the hash and line are checked against the source snapshot
a rule hit carries a rule id and a closed category only: no message, snippet or matched line (mobsfscan output embeds raw source lines)
each tool instance's result_record_count equals the number of rule hits attributed to it
static mobile evidence is not runtime behaviour

outputs/tool-results.json, outputs/coverage.json and the applicability probe receipt validate against tool-results, scan-coverage and applicability-probe-receipt schemas and pass tool_instance_shapes.validate_node_aggregate for the node status; every listed output matches the attempt bytes (verify_outputs_on_disk)
the applicability probe receipt is required for every node status, including SKIPPED; a SKIPPED node publishes an empty result and its receipt shows zero matching inputs for every declared tool
run_id, job_id, attempt_id and source_snapshot_sha256 agree across the result, tool-results.json, coverage.json and the probe receipt, and equal the worker envelope
every tool_id in the result resolves to a declared tool instance in tool-results.json, and records come only from an instance with a validated, hashed output
outputs/redaction-receipt.json verifies against the published outputs/ directory with evidence_redaction.verify_receipt under the consumer's policy and limits
the result is an evidence lead: it cannot promote to a finding, a severity or an observed runtime state; there is no field for running, listening, reachable, deployed, exploited or observed state
a clean or empty result is not proof of absence; zero analysed inputs is a named coverage gap, not a pass
cross-record rules are enforced by container_mobile_binary_contracts.validate_result and verify_attempt
the redaction receipt is verified against the published bytes before any published document is parsed; if it fails nothing else is inspected and no value read from the attempt is ever reported
status.json holds exactly the required_status_fields, each bound to the node status and the worker envelope
manifest.json is {schema appsec-review/attempt-manifest/1, contract_id, outputs[{path, sha256}]} naming exactly the files beneath outputs/ with the sha256 of their bytes
